_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Work Instruction (WI)
summary: Work Instructions (WI) document the detailed processes and steps required to safely, securely, and consistently operate Combined Tactical Training Ranges (CTTR).
use_relationship:
Work Instruction (WI) are documents that describe, in detail, the process and steps necessary to perform in order to complete a task associated with the secure, safe and consistent operation of the Combined Tactical Training Ranges (CTTR). A range has a complete set of WI when it has a book of procedures which identify and document every process necessary to fully operate the range. WI are used by the government to assess disciplined execution of processes, standardization, and consistent output.

This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Each Work Instruction (WI) shall be presented in a format similar to that of the WIs provided as Government Furnished Information (GFI) in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The WIs for each range shall identify every process necessary to fully operate the range. The WI shall contain all of the knowledge and information about a process into a fixed set of procedures used to perform that process.

children.title: Work instructions shall include procedures for all areas of range operations, including the following:
Each WI shall contain the following:

If applicable, the WI shall include flow charts, work flow diagrams, process maps and other quantifiable process charting tools to identify procedures/processes and point out relationships between procedures/processes.

The WI shall contain a description of the task to be performed from the initial step to the final step in such detail that a person with training in the appropriate skills is able to perform the process with little or no outside assistance.

The WI shall specify continuity in the execution of range processes, consistent competency and standards in task performance, consistent quality of process output, and a basis from which to measure performance.
The WI shall identify the common thread to bridge various range documents together that specify the processes required to accomplish complex processes.
